Vigilance is paramount to counter their destructive ambitions. We'll confront these threats by adhering to our core values. By uniting as one, we’ll prevail, safeguarding the freedoms that inspire us as a nation.

Throughout this period, we have had to contend with uncertainties. Nevertheless, the trials of the past have strengthened our spirit, leading us, now, to a new era of opportunity. With renewed vigor, we stand ready to create a better future for all. Our commitment remains steadfast.

Global stability depends on leaders who prioritize peace. We will work towards a more interconnected world. This mission requires constant endeavors to address challenges.

It has been the privilege of a lifetime to serve as your President. There have been moments of joy, times of struggle, and instances of profound challenge. Throughout it all, I’ve held steadfast to the belief that America is a nation of limitless possibilities, a beacon of hope for the world. Our collective spirit has seen us through turmoil, always. The path ahead, while sometimes hazy, is filled with the promise of progress. Let's move forward with our dedication, forging it together for all.

Every time I'm invited to this rostrum, I'm humbled by the privilege and mindful of the sacrifices that have secured it. It strengthens my resolve for further action. Public service is a call to duty, a sacred trust. Our mission is to safeguard this great nation, and the mission is clear. It requires clear thinking, decisive action, and unwavering determination. The stakes are high, but the rewards are even greater. We must remain focused, vigilant, and united.

I propose a new temporary worker program that will match willing foreign workers with willing employers when Americans are not available to fill jobs. This program will benefit our economy. It will allow employers to fill jobs that Americans are not being - choosing not to be. They'll fill jobs that Americans will not fill. And it's good for our economy.

America's immigration system is also outdated--unsuited to the needs of our economy and to the values of our country. The system must be reformed. These changes will reinforce our commitment to a just society driven by opportunity.

My administration understood that America could not retreat in the face of terror. And we responded. We built a global coalition to fight terror. We confronted threats before they reached our shores. We made the tough calls, and we saw challenges as opportunities. Now, we must remain vigilant, ensuring our security for generations to come. We'll continue to invest in defense to give our troops the tools they need. And we will never falter in the fight against those who threaten our way of life.

The story of children being just shuffled through the system is one of the saddest stories I know. And I want to make sure no child is left behind anywhere in America. Every child deserves the chance to learn and grow in a nurturing setting. We must guarantee equal access to opportunities for every kid, eliminating barriers that impede their progress. The future of our nation rests on fostering their full potential. A society that cares for its children invests in its future, ensuring a bright tomorrow for all.

We are a nation of compassion, willing to lend a hand to our neighbors, near and far. We believe in the promise of a free and open society where all Americans can realize their dreams. Our resolve to safeguard liberty and enhance opportunity remains our guiding star. We stand confident.

Our first goal is clear: We must have an economy that grows fast enough to create good jobs with rising wages for all Americans. That means we must unleash the power of free enterprise, innovation, and entrepreneurship, promoting a climate where every citizen can chase their dreams. A robust economy enables prosperity, and we will remain dedicated to policies that support sustained expansion. We will strive to strengthen our nation's financial foundations for future generations, ensuring resilience and long-term economic health.

Strategic investments and policy changes will be essential. A bold vision for the future is needed.
